Join our GPU System Test team and help ensure continued success for the Mali GPUs - technology that powers millions of devices worldwide. Our team focuses on system-level testing of the Vulkan, OpenGL ES and DirectX graphics APIs, developing and analyzing automated test solutions for real-world workloads to ensure our GPUs perform reliably and efficiently across platforms. This is a unique opportunity to: Build your technical expertise in graphics and system testing; Collaborate with experienced engineers across multiple fields; Help define how Arm’s GPU technology is tested and validated for millions of users around the world. Responsibilities: Develop and run automated tests for Arm’s Mali GPU drivers; Validate graphics performance, functionality, stability, and compatibility at the system level; Contribute to new test frameworks, pipelines, and analysis tools; Collaborate closely with developers, automation engineers, and performance specialists across the GPU organization. Required Skills and Experience: Hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent experience in Computer science, Electrical engineering or a related field; Has experience of high-level programming (Python preferred); Has an analytical approach and ability to analyse logs and test results. “Nice To Have” Skills and Experience: Experience from working with software testing of embedded devices; Experience with shell scripting (PowerShell or Bash preferred); Experience with Git.
